title: Dinner With Live Music Near Bangalore: Friday Jams & Saturday Bands
description: Want live bands while having dinner? Fernway by Stories hosts a candlelight jam every Friday (11pm–2am) and a live band every Saturday, in an open-air garden near Bangalore.
imageAlt: Open-air shell and garden tables at Fernway by Stories, where music nights happen
keywords: live music dinner Bangalore Mysore highway

sections.heading: Our weekly music nights
paragraphs: Music at Fernway is built around dinner — loud enough to feel, soft enough to talk over.
list: Plus DJ and lounge nights, themed evenings and seasonal events through the year

sections.heading: Why it's different from a city music venue
paragraphs: Many live-music spots in the city are indoors and crowded. At Fernway, {{saturdayBand}}, under the open sky, with tables spread across greenery — so you get the band and still get a proper dinner.
Our kitchen serves North Indian favourites, global comfort food, desserts and coffee, and we stay open till 6am, so the night doesn't have to end when the music does.

sections.heading: Plan your night
paragraphs: Music nights are our busiest, so book ahead online or call {{phone}}. For the latest line-up, check our events page or Instagram.
